mn145:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn145:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Puṇṇo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallanā vuṭṭhito yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Puṇṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn145:2.1: Sādhu maṃ, bhante, Bhagavā saṃkhittena ovādena ovadatu yam ahaṃ Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan ti.
mn145:2.2: Tena hi, Puṇṇa, suṇohi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn145:2.3: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Puṇṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn145:3.1: Santi kho, Puṇṇa, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn145:3.2: Tañ ce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati,
mn145:3.3: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī;
mn145:3.9: manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn145:3.10: Tañ ce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati,
mn145:3.11: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya titthato uppajjati nandī;
mn145:4.1: Santi ca kho, Puṇṇa, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn145:4.2: Tañ ce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn145:4.3: tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandī nirujjhati:
mn145:4.9: manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn145:4.10: Tañ ce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati,
mn145:4.11: tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandī nirujjhati;
mn145:5.1: Iminā ca tvaṃ, Puṇṇa, mayā saṃkhittena ovādena ovadito katarasmiṃ janapade viharissasīti?
mn145:5.2: Iminā 'haṃ, bhante, Bhagavatā saṃkhittena ovādena ovadito, atthi Sunāparanto nāma janapado, tatthāhaṃ viharissāmi.
mn145:5.5: Sace taṃ, Puṇṇa, Sunāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti, tattha te, Puṇṇa, kinti bhavissatīti?
mn145:5.6: Sace maṃ, bhante, Sunāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti, tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.7: Bhaddakā vat' ime Sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat' ime Sunāparantakā manussā yam me na-y-ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentīti.
mn145:5.10: Sace pana te, Puṇṇa, Sunāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāraṃ dassanti, tattha pana te, Puṇṇa, kinti bhavissatīti?
mn145:5.11: Sace me, bhante, Sunāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāraṃ dassanti, tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.12: Bhaddakā vat' ime Sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat' ime Sunāparantakā manussā yam me na-y-ime leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dentīti.
mn145:5.15: Sace pana te, Puṇṇa, Sunāparantakā manussā leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dassanti, tattha pana te, Puṇṇa, kinti bhavissatīti?
mn145:5.16: Sace me, bhante, Sunāparantakā manussā leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dassanti, tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.17: Bhaddakā vat' ime Sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat' ime Sunāparantakā manussā yam me na-y-ime daṇḍena pahāraṃ dentīti.
mn145:5.20: Sace pana te . . . daṇḍena . . . kinti bhavissatīti?
mn145:5.21: Sace me, bhante, Sunāparantakā manussā daṇḍena . . .
mn145:5.25: Sace pana te . . . satthena . . . kinti bhavissatīti?
mn145:5.30: Sace pana te . . . jīvitā voropessanti . . . kinti bhavissatīti?
mn145:5.31: Sace maṃ . . . jīvitā voropessanti, tattha me evaṃ bhavissati:
mn145:5.32: Santi kho Bhagavato sāvakā kāyena ca jīvitena ca aṭṭiyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakaṃ pariyesanti. Tam me idaṃ apariyitthaṃ yeva satthahārakaṃ laddhan ti.
mn145:6.2: Sakkhissasi kho tvaṃ, Puṇṇa, iminā damupasamena samannāgato Sunāparantasmiṃ janapade viharituṃ.
mn145:6.3: Yassa dāni tvaṃ, Puṇṇa, kālam maññasīti.
mn145:7.1: Atha kho āyasmā Puṇṇo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Sunāparanto janapado tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
mn145:7.2: Anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sunāparanto janapado tad avasari.
mn145:7.3: Tatra sudaṃ āyasmā Puṇṇo Sunāparantasmiṃ janapade viharati.
mn145:7.4: Atha kho āyasmā Puṇṇo ten' ev' antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭipādesi, ten' ev' antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsikāsatāni paṭipādesi, ten' ev' antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchi-akāsi.
mn145:7.5: Atha kho āyasmā Puṇṇo aparena samayena parinibbāyi.
mn145:8.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
mn145:8.2: Yo so, bhante, Puṇṇo nāma kulaputto Bhagavatā saṃkhittena ovādena ovadito, so kālakato.
mn145:8.3: Tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo ti?
mn145:8.4: Paṇḍito, bhikkhave, Puṇṇo kulaputto; paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ; na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ viheṭhesi.
mn145:8.7: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti. 146.
